batch_node.name: Samsite Compliance pages v0.3.0 — sequence-nav back/forward selector on SSP + POA&M
batch_node.description: Seeds two sibling Samsite compliance pages hosting the ROSCALE OSCAL workbench panels: /samsite/compliance/ssp and /samsite/compliance/poam. v0.3.0 mounts a tap_web sequence-nav panel ABOVE each workbench (a sibling, not a modification of the roscale panel): both panels read the same entity_id_var, the nav panel resolves the full ordered emission sequence (compliance_artifact of the kind, newest-first by fetched_at) and renders Older/Newer links that flip that var plus a 'N of M' position indicator. v0.2.x migrated the panel configs to the canonical tap_web.panels.entity_resolution contract (entity_id_var + fallback.{query, description}); those are unchanged.

node.name: Samsite OSCAL SSP Workbench
node.description: ROSCALE SSP workbench panel instance for Samsite's compliance/oscal page. Resolves via tap_web.panels.entity_resolution: URL deep link via oscal_ssp_artifact_entity_id wins; otherwise the fallback Gryphon query selects the latest oscal_ssp compliance_artifact by fetched_at.

fallback.query: MATCH (a:compliance_core__compliance_artifact) WHERE a.data.kind = "oscal_ssp" AND a.data.fetched_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.data.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1
fallback.description: Latest oscal_ssp compliance artifact by fetched_at.

node.name: Samsite OSCAL SSP Sequence Nav
node.description: Back/forward selector over OSCAL SSP emissions. Shares oscal_ssp_artifact_entity_id with the SSP workbench below it; resolves the full newest-first sequence of oscal_ssp compliance_artifacts by fetched_at and renders Older/Newer links + position.

sequence.query: MATCH (a:compliance_core__compliance_artifact) WHERE a.data.kind = "oscal_ssp" AND a.data.fetched_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.data.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 200
sequence.label: OSCAL SSP

batch_node.name: Samsite KSI Scoreboard page v0.2.1 — canonical multi-entity resolution (Gryphon double-quoted literals)
batch_node.description: Seeds /samsite/compliance/scoreboard hosting the samsite-ksi-scoreboard panel — a synthesized roll-up that joins the on-grid FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (ksi_indicator + ksi_theme) against the latest OSCAL SSP and POA&M emissions to compute per-indicator passing/in-progress/accepted/gap status. v0.2.0 migrates the panel config to the canonical tap_web.panels.entity_resolution multi-entity contract (req-web-panel-entity-resolution-multi): `<role>_entity_id_var` replaces `<role>_artifact_entity_id_var`; `fallback.<role>.{query, description}` replaces flat `fallback.<role>_kind`. Each per-role fallback uses envelope ORDER BY + LIMIT plus defensive IS NOT NULL.

node.name: Samsite KSI Scoreboard
node.description: Synthesized 20x KSI scoreboard. Resolves the latest oscal_ssp + oscal_poam compliance_artifacts via tap_web.panels.entity_resolution (multi-entity, roles `ssp` and `poam`) and joins them against ksi_indicator nodes on the grid. URL deep links: ?oscal_ssp_artifact_entity_id=<id>&oscal_poam_artifact_entity_id=<id>.

ssp.query: MATCH (a:compliance_core__compliance_artifact) WHERE a.data.kind = "oscal_ssp" AND a.data.fetched_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.data.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1
ssp.description: Latest oscal_ssp compliance artifact by fetched_at.

poam.query: MATCH (a:compliance_core__compliance_artifact) WHERE a.data.kind = "oscal_poam" AND a.data.fetched_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.data.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1
poam.description: Latest oscal_poam compliance artifact by fetched_at.
